newsitem.title: UK: LME copper off lows but still below $2,500.
newsitem.headline: LME copper off lows but still below $2,500.

text.p: COPPER - Bounces off day's lows but still down sharply after early sell-off. Off $69 at $2,498. Spread flares out to $138/$142 amid stubborn tightness in nearby dates.
ALUMINIUM - Down with copper but also off lows. Down $4 at $1,574.
ZINC - Follows similar pattern. Down $5 at $1,395.
LEAD - Quiet, easier. TIN - Unchanged. OTHERS - Softer.
